entities.summary: Charles Grey, 1st Earl Grey, was a British Army general and governor. He was a distinguished soldier in a generation of exceptionally capable military personnel, and his leadership of British troops was prominent during the Seven Years' War (1756–1763), the U.S. War of Independence, and the French Revolutionary Wars.
